gloss: to bring close; to press (one's body, cheek) against

definitions.gloss: to bring close together; to press together
definitions.explanation: To physically bring two things close together so they touch or are side by side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り⟦{寄|よ}せて→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧きた。
examples.english: The cat pressed its body against me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り⟦{寄|よ}せて→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧⟦{甘|あま}える→甘える：06624_amaeru⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ども。
examples.english: A child snuggling their cheek close and acting affectionately.
The dog nuzzled its nose up against me.

notes:
Combines {擦|す}る (to rub) and ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring near). Also written with the kanji {摺|す}り⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to press one's cheek against
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to press one's body close

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {擦|す}り⟦{寄|よ}る→寄る：02440_yoru⟧: to sidle up to — intransitive version; the subject moves close, rather than bringing things together
- ⟦{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る→歩み寄る：13197_ayumiyoru⟧: to compromise, to meet halfway — emphasizes mutual concession
- すり{合|あ}わせる: to coordinate, to compare and adjust — used for schedules, documents, and detailed alignment

USAGE:
To reconcile opinions or figures is すり{合|あ}わせる (⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すり{合|あ}わせる), not {擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる.
